reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Universal Access through securing ARV treatments , strengthening of PMTCT and strengthening HIV prevention for most at risk populations - Burkina Faso (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Burkina Faso, HIV, Secrétariat Permanent du Conseil National de Lutte contre le Sida et les Infections Sexuellement Transmissibles (SP/CNLS-IST) (SP/CNLS-IST)This program has the following goals: Reduce HIV prevalence from 1.0% to 0.83% by end 2017. Reduce new infections by 21% from 5,892 (4,408 among adults and 1,484 among children) in 2014 to 4,642 (3,248 among adults and 1,394 among children) in 2017 (Spectrum 2014). Reduce the rate of mother-child HIV transmission to less than 5% by end of 2017. The objectives of this program are: Improve program management and availability, quality and use of strategic information. Increase the coverage of ARV treatment among children and adults living with HIV from 41% (46,623 / 114,335) at the end of 2014 to 58% (68,904 / 118,480) by end of 2017
